## Summary of 2025 Esports World Cup Dota 2 Results

Team Spirit won the 2025 Esports World Cup Dota 2 tournament, defeating Team Falcons 3-0 in the Grand Final. Team Spirit dominated the tournament, losing only one match in the opening round of the group stage against Xtreme Gaming.

In the playoffs, Team Spirit defeated Gaimin Gladiators 2-0 in the quarterfinal and won 2-0 against Parivision in the semifinal. Team Spirit won a $1 million first place prize and secured 1,000 Club Championship points. Team Spirit's Magomed "Collapse" Khalilov was named MVP for his outstanding performances winning $10,000.

## Tournament Overview
The Esports World Cup 2025 by Dota 2 took place from July 8-19 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with 16 teams competing for a $3 million prize pool.

## Team Yandex Performance
Team Yandex was one of two teams that hadn't played any LAN tournaments that year before entering the competition. During the group stage, Team Yandex defeated Virtus.pro with a 2:0 series victory.

However, their tournament run ended relatively early. Team Yandex lost their elimination match against Gaimin Gladiators with a 0:2 series loss. They finished in the 9-12 place range and earned $75,000 in prize money.

The team was led by players including TA2000, CHIRA JUNIOR, Noticed, prblms, and Solo.
